changes.reason: Native integers enter as int64, and an int outside the safe-integer range loses precision as a native number, so these forms need a distinct value class to preserve the int kind.
An integral native number enters as int, so an integral float needs a distinct value class to preserve its kind and signed zero.
A UTF-8 native string enters as text, so UTF-8 bytes need a distinct value class to preserve their kind.
An array with sequence keys enters as list, so a map with those keys needs a distinct value class to preserve its kind.

The bindings admit only immutable Schema values that schema.load has validated, so schema_invalid and schema_hash_mismatch belong to that factory rather than to query.new; native lazy Schema constructors retain their validation behavior.
